The '''TIE/se Bomber''', also known as the '''First Order TIE bomber''', was a class of [[TIE series|TIE fighter series]] [[bomber]] using by the [[First Order]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] with the [[Resistance]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:JulJerjerrod-SWZ.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Jul Jerjerrod]] piloting a TIE/se Bomber in battle around a ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer.]]
The TIE/se Bomber,<ref name="Asmodee">{{Asmodee|subdomain=shop|url=catalogue/x-wing-2nd-ed-fury-of-the-first-order-squadron-pack_3870|text=Star Wars X-Wing 2nd Ed: Fury of the First Order}}</ref> also known as the First Order TIE bomber,<ref name="Bucket's list">{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-no-place-safe-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 6 Fun Facts from "No Place Safe" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}}</ref> was a series of bomber used by the [[First Order]]. The craft had two central pods, one of which had a [[cockpit]]. The new version featured notched wings, like the [[TIE/IN interceptor|original Imperial TIE Interceptor]].<ref name="Allegiance 1" /> The engine bank at the rear was squared off,<ref name="No Place Safe">{{Resistance|No Place Safe}}</ref> and it had four [[solar collector]]s that also acted as its wings, with four [[laser cannon]]s on each forward tip. The wings themselves were angled outwards.<ref name="Allegiance 1" />

==History==
[[File:TIEBomber-Allegiance1.png|thumb|right|250px|TIE/se bombers over Tah'Nuhna]]
The First Order also made use of a [[bomber]] known simply as a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|First Order bomber]], which had a closer resemblance to the older Imperial TIE/sa bomber.<ref name="Bomber Command">''[[The Last Jedi: Bomber Command]]''</ref> At one point during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the First Order and the [[Resistance]], a number of TIE/se Bombers were [[Battle of Aeos Prime|deployed]] to the [[planet]] [[Aeos Prime]].<ref name="No Place Safe" /> After the [[Battle of Crait]], they were deployed to [[bomb]] areas as part of the [[destruction of Tah'Nuhna]].<ref name="Allegiance 1" /> The bombers were deployed again in an [[Battle of Barabesh|attempt to destroy]] the ''[[Colossus]]'' in the [[Barabesh system]].<ref name="The Escape">{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}}</ref> "[[Dread]]" flew a TIE/se in a battle with Resistance [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]]s.<ref name="Dread Card">{{FFGXW2|set=Fury of the First Order Squadron Pack|cardname="Dread"}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The original TIE bomber had wings similar to the TIE Advanced, but the Interceptor-inspired wings give the First Order TIE bomber a more aggressive feel. The wing angles are also reversed. Both of these changes helped the bomber to have a more unique silhouette from the front and the top, to distinguish it from the other TIE ships.|[[Amy Beth Christenson]]|<ref name="Bucket">{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-no-place-safe-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 6 Fun Facts from "No Place Safe" - ''Star Wars Resistance''|date=2020-01-13}}</ref>}}
The TIE/se Bomber first appeared in [[Allegiance 1|''Allegiance'' 1]], a comic written by [[Ethan Sacks]] and illustrated by [[Luke Ross]]. The comic was published by [[Marvel Comics]]<ref name="Allegiance 1" /> on [[October 9]], [[2019]].<ref name="Preview">{{SW|url=news/journey-to-star-wars-the-rise-of-skywalker-allegiance-1-exclusive|text=The First Order Strikes Back in ''Journey to Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker - Allegiance'' #1 - Exclusive|date=2019-10-02}}</ref> The TIE was identified as a "First Order TIE bomber" in the article "[https://web.archive.org/web/20230606075358/https://www.starwars.com/news/buckets-list-extra-no-place-safe-star-wars-resistance Bucket's List Extra: 6 Fun Facts from 'No Place Safe' - ''Star Wars Resistance'']," posted to [[StarWars.com]] on [[January 13]], [[2020]].<ref name="Bucket" /> Later, the model was identified as "TIE/se Bomber" in the ''[[Fury of the First Order Squadron Pack]]'' expansion pack for [[Atomic Mass Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Second Edition]]'',<ref name="Fury">{{FFGXW2|set=Fury of the First Order Squadron Pack}}</ref> which released on [[September 24]], [[2021]].<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|username=atomicmassgames|url=status/1418616974523895815|name=[[Atomic Mass Games]]|date=2021-07-23|quote=This product releases September 24.|archivedate=20210723170031}}</ref>

The bomber was designed for ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]''{{'s}}<ref name="Bucket" /> [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season's]] sixteenth episode, "[[No Place Safe]]," which released on [[January 12]], 2020.<ref name="Air">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref> [[Aaron Pham]] completed three pages of concept art for the bomber on [[August 21]], [[2018]].<ref name="Bucket" /><ref name="Slide 11">{{SW|url=no-place-safe-concept-art-gallery|text="No Place Safe" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 11}}</ref><ref name="Slide 12">{{SW|url=no-place-safe-concept-art-gallery|text="No Place Safe" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 12}}</ref> While the double pods were taken from the original [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE bomber]], its wings were inspired by [[TIE/IN interceptor|Interceptor]] for an aggressive presence, but with reversed angles. The changes to the wings provided the bomber with a unique silhouette, helping to distinguish it from other TIE models.<ref name="Bucket" />
